subject: Playbook + Onramp: agreed scope, success metrics & prompt set
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivers <alex@clearline.ai>, Priya Menon <priya@clearline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Playbook + Onramp: agreed scope, success metrics & prompt set

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed onramp so we can lock the kickoff date:

What we heard (pain + goal):
- Search relevance for support articles is slipping (users reporting bad matches at longer tail queries).
- Current embedding pipeline has ~350ms 95th percentile latency and cost is trending higher than expected for the production workload.
- Your team needs an evaluation that preserves PHI-sensitive handling and demonstrates predictable unit economics.

Proposed 4-week pilot scope (high level):
- Ingest and index a ~50k document sample from your support corpus (anonymized subset we discussed).
- Run embedding + rerank evals against the provided prompt set (see attached sample_promptset).
- Measure: 75th and 95th percentile query latency, embedding recall@10, and token unit cost delta vs current baseline.

Success metrics (billing & quality targets):
- 75th percentile latency <= 200ms (query path, end-to-end).
- Embedding recall@10 >= 0.85 on the annotated eval set.
- Demonstrable cost improvement: >= 40% reduction in token cost for the evaluated workload (through batching + quantization).

Owners and roles:
- Clearline: Priya Menon (technical lead) — data provisioning + evaluation acceptance.
- Clearline: Alex Rivers — commercial lead and contract point-of-contact.
- Redwood: Ben Carter — solutions/engineering owner (model selection, infra).
- Redwood: Mina Haddad — customer success (onboarding, prompt/eval coordination).

Immediate access/setup asks (what we need from Clearline to start):
1) S3 read access to the anonymized sample bucket (credentials or temp IAM role).
2) A service account email we can add to the sandbox project for logs + metrics.
3) A small set of representative queries and labeled relevance judgments (attached: clearline_sample_promptset_v1.json).

Attachments: redwood_poc_checklist_v2.pdf (onboarding checklist) and clearline_sample_promptset_v1.json (prompt/eval stubs).

Next steps / timing:
- If we get the access items above by Friday 12/10, we can kickoff the sandbox build on Monday 12/13 and run the four-week sprint ending 1/10.
- Can you confirm Priya & Alex are comfortable with those dates? Also confirm any procurement or legal gating we should loop in now.

Thanks — I’ll wait for a short confirmation and then Ben will send the technical kickoff agenda and a stubbed mutual action plan.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---
From: Alex Rivers <alex@clearline.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@clearline.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook + Onramp: agreed scope, success metrics & prompt set

Jonas —

Appreciate the crisp recap. This aligns with our expectations. A couple clarifications:
1) We don’t have PHI in this pilot dataset, but some records are PII-sensitive; we’ll need the VPC sandbox you mentioned rather than public hosted.
2) Procurement wise we’ll need a short SOW (1 page) and an NDA addendum — can your legal team provide a template?

Regarding dates, Monday 12/13 works for a technical kickoff. Priya will get the sample artifact and a service account to you by Friday 12/10.

Also — do you recommend a particular embedding model/quantization profile for initial tests? If you can put a brief options note in the MAP Ben will share, that helps Priya prioritize.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivers
Head of Product | Clearline AI
alex@clearline.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivers <alex@clearline.ai>, Priya Menon <priya@clearline.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan + quick tech agenda (draft)

Hi all —

Following Jonas’ note, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a 30-minute technical kickoff agenda. Draft bullets below — happy to update after Alex/Priya confirmation.

MAP (draft):
- 12/10 by EOD: Clearline shares S3 access and service account (Priya).
- 12/13: Technical kickoff (30–45m) — agenda: sandbox topology, data ingest approach, eval harness, success metric definitions.
- 12/14–12/17: Sandbox build & model candidate smoke tests (Redwood infra + quantization profiles).
- Week of 12/20: Full eval runs (embedding index + rerank), weekly sync every Tue.
- 1/10: Final readout, recommendations, and next steps (commercial/scale discussion).

Tech agenda (12/13 kickoff):
1) Introductions + brief goals (5m)
2) Sandbox topology and VPC requirements (10m)
3) Data ingest & sample format (10m)
4) Eval harness, prompts, and labels (10m)
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

Model/quantization note (short):
- We’ll start with a 4-bit quantized embedding candidate that has shown a ~30–50% cost improvement in similar workloads; if recall drops materially we’ll test 8-bit fallback profiles. Ben will share the candidate names in the kickoff doc.

Links: HubSpot deal (see related_links) and onboarding checklist attached. Also adding a DocuSign stub for a short SOW to the HubSpot deal.

If everything looks good, I’ll lock the 12/13 kickoff and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + quick tech agenda (draft)

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and aligns with internal timing. A few quick notes:
- Confirmed: Priya will own data handoff (S3 + sample labels) and will post the IAM role by 12/10 EOD.
- Sandbox: we require VPC peering for the sandbox (not public internet ingestion) — can Redwood ops confirm the minimal network ports and egress expectations?
- Security: we’ll need an SOC2 scoping call before we send any even-anonymized labels; can Mina coordinate a 30-minute security checklist call with our InfoSec next week?

Once we have the short SOW & NDA addendum from your legal, Alex will route procurement.

Looking forward — Priya
Priya Menon
Technical Lead | Clearline AI
priya@clearline.ai
